query:
UPDATE vehicles 
SET mainImageUrl = (
  SELECT imageUrl 
  FROM vehicle_images 
  WHERE vehicleId = vehicles.id 
  AND sortOrder = 0 
  LIMIT 1
)
WHERE id = (SELECT MIN(id) FROM (SELECT id FROM vehicles) AS temp);
